text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, wait, wait, it's over alr... eady?
—I-I wanted to see more...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Incredible... Sprint races are over in an instant like this.
My eyes are still flickering...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I want to see... even more!
Who's gonna win this time...!?

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
—...!!
Amazing...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Top of the line speed right now!
This is where it's at...!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"...I've gotta get stronger, too!
Time to start the training arc!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
1,400 meters...
They took it from me... gahhh!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
A loss is a loss! It seems my speed...
might have fallen short of the winner's...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However! This time for sure! There are still races left that I cannot lose!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Of course,
you understand, right?!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: The Mile Championship... right?

The Mile CS, true to its name,
is a race to determine the 1,600m "Champion."

A Mile GⅠ that stands shoulder to shoulder with the Yasuda Kinen in spring.
It is one of the highest peaks an Umamusume on the sprint/mile route can reach.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: "In the Yasuda Kinen, you made me eat your dust..."

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
However!!
In the upcoming GⅠ! I will crown it all with a glorious finale!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Are you sure about that, Bakushin O-chan?
That spot is for my best outfit—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"If you claim that is your best!
Then surpassing it is what makes one—the strongest!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
Fufufufu...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Fufufu... Fuhuhu!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! Ah, wonderful!
You truly are simply wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Aah-hah-hah! Precisely!
And that applies to you as well, Flight-san!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"Running alongside you right now
is the most fun of all!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Same here,
Bakushin O!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I just love clashing our personalities
together like this right now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"This must be what they call mutual love!
Well then—"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Will it be our class representative with model speed?!
Or will it be our trendiest speedster?!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
—Let us settle right now
who is truly the 'strongest'!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: A conclusion...

North Flight returned after her defeat...
with a hint of hesitation lingering on her face.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
This outfit is mine.
I am the one who should wear it.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I have pride in my best coordination.
That's precisely why this stings. However..."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The more I run, the more I feel...
the wonderful individuality of everyone...
of Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Inherently...
no one's 'true self' is superior to another's."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And yet, in a race...
a winner and loser are inevitably decided.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Will that really be okay?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...You're right, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I understand.
It's precisely because the path is so harsh that the brilliance shines brighter.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"Still... today's race was just so much fun.
Though I lost, so I really shouldn't
be indulging in such soft thoughts."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
choice_data_list: That's precisely why we should take pride in our individuality.

text_block_list.text:
Umamusume have various aptitudes. As such,
the annual awards given to standout Umamusume
are divided into detailed categories.

It is the culmination of history, where each individual stayed true to their brilliant uniqueness and clashed with one another.
North Flight is now right in the midst of that very history.
choice_data_list: If you stay true to your intense individuality, something is sure to change.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Yes... I believe in you.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
The Mile Championship... I will cast aside all naivety.
I will pour everything I have into winning.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And—
I will reach our future!
The post-race press conference. Naturally, the showdown with Sakura Bakushin O was the main focus... but this time, there was another major topic.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
—North Flight-san has won the Yasuda Kinen.
And the next race she will be challenging is the Mile CS...

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
Only three Umamusume in history have achieved
back-to-back victories in this crucial mile race.

text_block_list.name: Reporter
text_block_list.text:
If you achieve this, North Flight-san,
a new page of history will be written!
How are you feeling about it!?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: That too... is one of the things shaping the future.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I will simply...
stay true to my own individuality."

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
It's just like fashion. Powerful individuality
appearing across the ages... is what has changed the world.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll beat Bakushin O-chan in my own way,
and conquer the Spring and Autumn Mile double.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
And,
something no one has ever seen before—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I will wear
the greatest radiance!

The culmination of North Flight's three years. And now,
the stage for her final showdown with Sakura Bakushin O—
she takes on the Mile Championship!
